cues.text: A colony ship streaks down through a starry, deep blue sky.
Below, towering, curved rock formations rise from a turquoise sea, leaning out over the water.
Vibrant alien birds glide past narrow waterfalls cascading from the lushly forested cliffs.
Gentle waves lap the white sand of a pristine beach framed by lush ferns.

beats.note: A bright streak of a colony ship descends through the deep blue, starry sky in the upper right.
The ship's trail fades. Towering, curved rock formations covered in lush vegetation rise from a turquoise sea.
Vibrant alien birds with long tails fly past narrow waterfalls cascading from the rocks.
The birds fly out of view.
The view rests on the white sand beach and gentle waves, framed by foreground ferns.
